basis: User instruction of 25 September 2026: use GPT-6 Sol and GPT-5.6 Sol High; reserve Astra for bounded review or critical blockers.

slots.trigger: Focused audit of implemented SQL/validation, report, source-apply and cleanup boundaries before T24.
slots.scope: Read-only residual review after independent Sol: SQL/written-column coverage, sealed report trust, exact source apply and cleanup/unknown-outcome boundaries. No implementation, cloud action or approval.

slots.trigger: Delta-only final safety audit if material safety changes since A1; otherwise skip. May instead be spent on a qualifying critical blocker.

astra.critical_blocker_trigger: Reproducible unresolved defect threatening SQL confinement, data validation, credential boundaries, approval, at-most-once apply or recovery; provide a minimal reproducer and two materially different failed Sol repair/diagnosis attempts unless immediate data safety warrants earlier expert review.
excluded_triggers: long AWS restore with known pending state
astra.one_session_completion: One bounded investigation and findings handoff, then close. Do not keep Astra running to implement fixes, poll status or do follow-up chores. A reopened/new extended investigation consumes another slot.
astra.after_limit: Do not spawn Astra again without an explicit user extension. Continue safe Sol work and keep any unresolved safety gate blocked.
astra.unavailable_behavior: Use a genuinely independent Sol High review with the same test/evidence bar and disclose the substitute; never claim Astra ran or waive a safety defect.
astra.critical_blocker_preferred_slot: A2; retain A1 for pre-apply boundary review where possible

budget_enforcement: Workflow admission rule and observable ledger, not a native Codex spend cap. Actual vendor account limits and usage telemetry are separate. No monetary or allowance savings percentage is promised.
invariants: All 36 primary tasks remain Sol High.
Same mandatory tests and human gates as V2 plus V3 additions.
No model opinion resolves an unknown database commit.
An Astra review is never human product approval.
